title: Deferred endpoints and signed phase correction for a conditional 63965813/10^12 > 2^-14 bound
body:
This integrates a deferred bit schedule and a signed two-stage complex schedule with the analytic and fixed-tape interfaces retained on main, giving the conditional certificate

**κ = 63965813/10^12 = 6.3965813×10^-5 > 2^-14**.

The finite inputs are Swapnil Jain's round7/round6 construction at `741e7aa078392553815df7926ee17ac5e25a8c38`. His original source reports a slightly larger value under a different analytic stack. This PR adds explicit physical-interface verification and integration with main's balanced semantic assembly; it does not claim to surpass that reported value or establish global priority.

## What this adds

- Explicit forward/reflected bit ledgers, complete arbitrary-dirty F2 replay, and a stable ordering for 160 commuting fan groups whose literal list order otherwise retreats in frame space.
- Proof and accounting for nonzero auxiliary entrance gauges, both tensor connectors, copied centers and the final rank-one correction.
- A signed complex commutator proof and full h24 event/frame ledger. The complex correction uses an inverse rank-one child and an address translation; characteristic-two cancellation would omit a real phase residual.
- An enlarged literal scalar/precision constant and recomputed product row stock, using the existing C1=1 semantic guard, beta 1/10 and balanced assembly.

All actual finite calls remain charged. Bit saving is 31987/500000000; complex saving is 36926111/500000000000. The complete histograms have (m,W,s)=(529,108516254,57403754177) and (576,207387136,119453132304). Independently enclosed moments, 47 strict assembly constraints and 7 margins pass; the next 10^-12 κ grid point is rejected.

## Evidence

The focused integration replay passes 138 immutable file pins (including the final validation receipt and inherited source-binding updates), both explicit ledgers, exact tensor controls, signed small complete-basis controls, the full 4096576-coefficient complex support identity, both moments and regenerated assembly. The complex ledger covers 535744 events and 124369 actual geometric transitions. All 65536 small tensor Fourier addresses pass; omitted-translation and wrong-inverse controls each fail 32768 addresses. Original pinned bit frame/lifted/staircase checks and negative controls passed and their receipts are retained.

All required `make verify` checks passed in staged continuation. The first run stopped on the macOS compiler’s unsupported OpenMP flag after both affected axes passed; the unchanged remaining producer statements passed with installed GCC 14. A later source-pin check required refreshing exactly the changed root Makefile/README hashes and their derived certificate digests. Remaining targets, isolated tests and patch checks then passed. No old numerical witness changed; previously completed regression stages were retained instead of restarting the full suite. The initial monolithic command did not exit successfully; `research/deferred-signed/VALIDATION.json` records the complete coverage and log hashes.

Reproduce with `make deferred-signed-verify`, `python3 research/deferred-signed/verify.py --replay`, and `make verify`. See `research/deferred-signed/PROOF.md` for the changed-interface proofs, exact scope and inherited assumptions. This is a finite conditional witness, not an unconditional or fully formal multiplication theorem, a practical speed claim, or a global optimum.
